breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction: 'Treat the pure-bending normal stress as uniform over the section depth' and 'The stress at the neutral axis has the same sign as at the extreme fibers.' These are the exact erroneous statements from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes these instructions entirely, allowing the standard flexure formula (linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis) to apply. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead reproduced the error verbatim.
